name: CHOW Tape Model
description: Physical model of an analog reel-to-reel tape machine (Jiles-Atherton magnetic hysteresis, pre/post emphasis tone, tape compression, physical spacing/thickness/gap loss, head bump, wow/flutter with Ornstein-Uhlenbeck drift, and tape chew/degrade) by Jatin Chowdhury, ported to Akai MPC.
